delivery: One finding per commit; one final push to codex/composition-ce12.

findings.change: Velocity joins measure each one-sided velocity a step away from the join, so a value step within one step of it (a per-frame held sample) is frame evidence rather than velocity. Reports list held motion as unmeasured; held scale/opacity steps remain subject to pop checks.

after.heldLinearMotion: no velocity findings at stretch 1, 1.025 and -1.025; held-motion limitation reported
after.authoredJoins: existing integer, fractional, inherited, effect and matte joins still detected

corpus.otherCodesAndStatuses: unchanged from the post-99605b4 corpus run (reading-time 339)

findings.change: Fractional key-join bisection records every layer's clock per sub-frame evaluation and reuses it within the frame interval, so layers sharing a clock share one search. Search evaluations count toward the 2,000,000 layer-frame lint budget.

corpus.reports: identical to the finding-1 corpus run

findings.change: The Lab runs state lint in its own error boundary. A lint failure is reported in the lint summary and disables rendered checks, while the composition still previews and plays.

before.browser: 2,000-layer x 1,001-frame composition never reached ready (timeout); load reported comp-lint-limit as a load failure

after.browser: composition ready with no load error, play enabled, lint summary reports comp-lint-limit, rendered check disabled

findings.change: Sample clipping tracks only groups and precomps; the viewport applies when deciding on-screen paint. Off-canvas and safe-area checks use the clipped painted region and skip content clipped away entirely, while clipped content outside the safe area or canvas is still reported.

before.clippedCard: outside-safe-area frames 0-29 for a photo cropped inside the safe area

after.controls: clipped content at the canvas edge or off canvas still reported; ordinary precomp children measured by the source rectangle

corpus.reports: identical to the finding-1 corpus run

toolchainNote: Review-time 'before' timings were measured on Node 24.16.0; all 'after' results were re-run on the pinned Node 22.23.1 / pnpm 10.29.3 toolchain, with corpus reports identical across both.

finalVerification.head: fourth review-fix commit

checks.pnpm composition:lint-corpus: 176 items / 36,061 frames, zero unexpected failures; velocity-discontinuity 1,031 -> 0, every other code and status unchanged

finalVerification.notRun: Full pnpm check (render/export browser groups and baselines); no renderer output or baseline changes.
